sense: the running of a business or of affairs

evidence: Cic. N.D. 1.2: cūrātiōne et administrātiōne rērum (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The managing of anything, a household or the state; Traupman’s administrāre is to manage on a large scale (p. 343).
The work of the dispēnsātor, the steward who kept the accounts.

phrases.latin: profectiōnem meam, ut videō, Erōtis dispēnsātiō impedit
phrases.english: my departure, as I see, is held up by Eros’ management of my money

sources: Lewis & Short: administratio · Lewis & Short: dispensatio
